subject: Renewal: premium SLA + burst commitment plan
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Johnson <claire@fluxpay.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-10T09:21:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal: premium SLA + burst commitment plan

Hi Claire,

Happy to be working with you on FluxPay's renewal. Based on the usage snapshot we've seen this quarter, there are a couple of paths to get FluxPay onto a premium support and latency SLO package that will cover your peak payment windows:

- Reserved capacity: 4 x A100-equivalent GPUs reserved (12-month term) + 20% discounted unit price
- Burst credits: 72 hours/month of on-demand burst capacity for traffic spikes
- SLO targets: p95 generation <= 150ms; p99 <= 350ms with automatic fallback to a compatible variant during overload

Can you confirm whether procurement needs a vendor pricing sheet and whether your security team requires any additional evidence? I've attached the usage summary you requested in case it helps.

If it works for you, propose a 30-min call this Thursday to review the SLO wording and pricing. Next steps we'd need from FluxPay:
- Preferred contract term (12 vs 24 months)
- Any hard latency SLO requirements during peak windows
- Procurement point of contact and signing authority

Thanks,

Aditya Rao
VP, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
(attachment: FluxPay_Q4_usage_summary.csv)

From: Claire Johnson <claire@fluxpay.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: FluxPay Procurement <procurement@fluxpay.com>
Date: 2026-12-11T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: premium SLA + burst commitment plan

Hi Aditya,

Thanks — this looks promising. A few quick notes from our side:

- Procurement will need a formal pricing worksheet and T&Cs. They typically allow 30 days to review.
- Our primary concern is tail latency during settlement windows (00:00–02:00 UTC). We need p99 to hold under our busiest day-of-month load.
- Can you confirm data residency options (US-only) and whether audit logs can be exported daily?

I'll loop in our engineering lead if we decide to move forward with a dedicated pool. Procurement contact is Sarah Lee (procurement@fluxpay.com).

Claire
Claire Johnson
Head of Platform, FluxPay
(attachment: FluxPay_Q4_usage_summary.csv)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Johnson <claire@fluxpay.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-12T14:33:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: premium SLA + burst commitment plan

Hi Claire — thanks for the quick response.

A few clarifications and commitments we can include in a formal proposal:

- SLOs: p95 <= 150ms; p99 <= 350ms measured at the API boundary. For settlement window protections we'll offer a targeted ramp plan (90-day onramp) and daily KV/prefix caching tuned for your workload.
- Capacity: Reserved pool (4 GPUs) plus 72 hours/month burst credits. We can add an automatic fallback policy to route non-critical traffic to a lower-cost variant during extreme overloads; this will preserve availability while protecting latency for priority routes.
- Data residency: US-only control plane + customer VPC option for your private deployment. Daily audit log export to your S3 bucket is supported.
- Pricing: 12-month commitment = standard table price - 20% discount; 24-month = -28%. We'll surface a line item for burst-credit allotment.

Attached is SLO_Proposal_v2 and a pricing workbook with line-item examples. Ben — can you confirm whether we can accommodate p99 testing during settlement windows as part of the pilot and propose language for credits if SLOs are missed?

Laura Bennett
Director, Product Operations | Redwood Inference
(attachments: slo_proposal_v2.pdf, capacity_pricing.xlsx)

Laura — this is very helpful. Procurement will review the pricing workbook and SLO wording this week. A couple of asks from our side before the formal contract:

- We'd like the 90-day onramp to include a 2-week paid pilot (reduced commitment) so we can validate p99 during settlement.
- Please include an explicit credits schedule for p99 misses during settlement windows (we'll share example language if helpful).
- We need the contract to include US-only data residency and daily export of audit logs to our bucket.

I'll reconvene with procurement and Sarah will reach out with redlines. Can you send a formal proposal and contract draft (redline-friendly doc) by EOD Wednesday?

Thanks,

Claire Johnson
Head of Platform, FluxPay
